item.title: Adeboye, Kumuyi, Olukoya are denominational heads, not fathers of Nigerian church - Rev. Isaac Omolehin
item.description: Founder of The Word Assembly Churches, Rev. Isaac Omolehin, has declared that Christianity in Nigeria lacks a unifying paternal figure, arguing that prominent church leaders are denominational heads rather than fathers of the entire body of Christ.

item.title: The Swift Ascendant lands in Abuja: Martell’s monumental journey of audacity reaches the Federal Capital Territory Abuja, Nigeria
item.description: After kicking off in Lagos, Martell’s nationwide campaign, Martell On The Move, has officially arrived in Abuja. The road trip features The Swift Ascendant, a monumental 14 foot art installation that is traveling across the country to connect with people through local art and nightlife.

item.title: Obasa hails Hon. Kehinde Joseph’s school building donation as model of effective representation
item.description: The Speaker of the Lagos State House of Assembly, Rt. Hon. (Dr.) Mudashiru Ajayi Obasa has commended Hon. Kehinde Olaide Joseph, the Alimosho Constituency II lawmaker, for building and donating a well-equipped block of classrooms to Abaranje Secondary School in the Ikotun area of the state, describing the gesture as a perfect example of effective representation and commitment to community development.

item.title: Adron Homes powers Ibadan Cultural Festival, strengthens cultural influence
item.description: Adron Homes and Properties Limited delivered a commanding performance at the grand finale of the 2026 Ibadan Cultural Festival, firmly establishing its dominance as Nigeria’s leading real estate brand. At the iconic Lekan Salami Stadium, Adamasingba, the company did not just sponsor the event, it took control of the narrative, transforming the cultural celebration into a powerful showcase of brand strength, innovation, and market authority.

item.title: How FirstBank is investing in Its people and building future leaders
item.description: For an average 9-5er, having a job isn’t enough. You want a career that grows with you, gives you stability, and opens doors to bigger opportunities. People everywhere are looking for workplaces that don’t just pay salaries but actually invest in their staff, helping them learn, lead, and succeed.

item.title: Aurikay: From Afrobeat roots to street to studio , giving back through music
item.description: Aurikay, the African‑American/Cameroonian Afrobeat sensation, is redefining what it means to be an artist with purpose. Known for her vibrant sound and cultural fusion, Aurikay is not just building a career she is building a movement.

item.title: Wole Arisekola's firm forges strategic alliance with Dubai's DAMAC Group
item.description: Arrayhan Nigeria Limited, led by CEO Mogaji Wole Arisekola, has announced a landmark partnership with the Dubai-based multinational real estate conglomerate, DAMAC Group.

item.title: Pasuma to light up Easter Sunday with electrifying performance at traffic light Lagos lounge
item.description: This Easter Sunday, all attention turns to The Traffic Light Lagos in Opebi, where the Fuji music icon Wasiu Alabi Pasuma, widely known as Pasuma Wonder - the Oganla of Fuji – is set to deliver a dynamic live show for entertainment enthusiasts.

item.title: Terra Cube wins ADVAN’s Biggest Award – Brand of the Year
item.description: Terra Cube has emerged as the biggest winner at the 2026 Advertisers Association of Nigeria (ADVAN) Marketing Excellence Awards, clinching the highly coveted Brand of the Year title, an honour widely regarded as the highest recognition of marketing excellence in Nigeria.

item.title: Nadabo Energy Boss, Abubakar Peters, re-arraigned over alleged N1.4bn oil fraud
item.description: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has rearraigned the Chief Executive Officer of Nadabo Energy, Abubakar Peters, at the Lagos State High Court in Ikeja over an alleged N1.4 billion oil subsidy fraud.

item.title: Adron Homes celebrates visionary chairman, Aare Adetola Emmanuel King, at 51
item.description: The management and staff of Adron Homes and Properties Limited have joined family, friends, associates, and well-wishers across the globe to celebrate their Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Aare Adetola EmmanuelKing, as he marks his 51st birthday.

item.title: Assessing slip and fall Lawyer Credentials in Las Vegas
item.description: In Las Vegas, the prevalence of slip and fall incidents highlights the importance of working with a proficient lawyer specialised in such cases. Recent reports indicate that these accidents rank among the leading causes of emergency room visits in the area, underscoring the potential severity and frequency of these occurrences.
